name: print-social-novacore-studio-banner-black-green-blue-gradient-glow
title: 'Novacore Studio' banner with a black-to-green-blue gradient glow and outlined service badges
whatItMeans: Sleek and confident; the diagonal gradient glow alone gives a plain service list a premium, high-tech backdrop.
whatItIs: A square banner with a black-to-green-to-blue diagonal gradient glow, a interlocking-square logo mark, 'NOVACORE STUDIO' wordmark, 'We specialize in:' with three outlined pill badges (3D, WEB, UX), a rounded URL bar and a blue 'VISIT US' button.
techniques: Use a diagonal gradient glow as the entire background.
Present specialties as simple outlined pill badges.
Combine a URL bar and CTA button into one rounded element.

vocabulary.definition: A diagonal colour fade used to light a dark background.
A small rounded outline label naming one item.
